title: feat(platform-objects): User Preferences and Identity Links leave Setup's menu; the User page gains a Preferences tab
body:
Fixes #23803

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Item 3 of the card: "User Preferences" and "Identity Links" leave Setup's menu, and each stays reachable from the user its rows belong to.

- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`: the `nav_accounts` (`sys_account`, view `all_links`) and `nav_user_preferences` (`sys_user_preference`, view `all_preferences`) entries are removed. A comment in their place records why, and where the rows are reached instead.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`: `SysUserDetailPage` gains a last tab, "Preferences" (en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES, like its siblings). It is a `record:related_list` over `sys_user_preference` on `user_id`, with the columns `key`, `created_at`, `updated_at` (the `all_preferences` view's columns minus `user_id`, which is the page's own record), sorted by `updated_at` descending like that view, 25 rows per page with the list's own paging. It authors no `add` and no `actions`. The existing "Linked Accounts" tab over `sys_account` is unchanged and serves "Identity links" (measured below), so no second tab is added.
- Translations: the two ids' labels leave `en.ts`, `zh-CN.ts`, `ja-JP.ts` and `es-ES.ts`, and their recorded digests leave the three `*.source-hashes.ts` tables (an orphan digest reds `source-hash.test.ts`). Both ids join `DEAD_SETUP_NAV_IDS` in `setup-nav-dead-key-tombstone.test.ts`, with their reason in its header.
- Tests in `packages/platform-objects`: the new `setup-nav-per-user-stores.test.ts` pins (1) no Setup entry this package contributes targets either object, by `objectName` or by a URL; (2) the User page has one related list over each object, keyed on `user_id`, accepted by `RecordRelatedListProps`, and the page parses through `PageSchema`; (3) the Preferences list shows a subset of the `all_preferences` columns and authors no `add` or `actions`; (4) `unlink_account` is a `list_item` action. In `caller-scoped-first-list-view.test.ts`, the non-vacuity control drops `sys_user_preference`, because no nav entry names it now and the population is derived from nav; a new case holds pin (a) for that object by name, and goes red if an entry names it again.
- `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts` (claim amendment 2): the two Setup-tree length pins move from 34 to 32, the count comment says 23 contributed entries, and the first case asserts `nav_accounts` and `nav_user_preferences` are absent. 32 is measured from the built packages: 8 groups (`group_approvals` is empty and collapses), plus 23 `platform-objects` entries, plus the MCP entry.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/platform-app-object-entry-views.test.ts` (claim amendment 3): the composed-boot copy of the same invariant gets the same change. `sys_user_preference` leaves the non-vacuity list, and a new case pins that no merged Setup or Account entry names it and that its first declared list view is still not caller-scoped (read from the composition, or else the identity barrel).
- `content/docs/ui/setup-app.mdx` (claim amendment 3): the Advanced row of the group table lists "OAuth Applications" only. No other sentence on the page names the two entries.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` (claim amendment 3): in `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render`, the Setup detail step no longer lists Identity Links and User Preferences among Setup's rendered destinations. It now has the runner open a user from Users and check the Preferences and Linked Accounts tabs. Revision 5 becomes 6, and no acceptance clause changes. The "45 Setup destinations" count is left as it is: it belongs to item 4, which whichever change lands last re-measures.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/identity-auth.json`: item `identity-auth.linked-accounts-social` cited `setup-nav.contributions.ts#nav_accounts`. It now cites `sys-user.page.ts#SysUserDetailPage`. Revision 3 becomes 4, as provenance only, with no clause change. Without the re-point, `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 1 (`ABSENT SYMBOL`, measured at `2abfd4b4c`).
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-account.object.ts` and `sys-user-preference.object.ts`: comments only. They no longer say a Setup entry names the object's unscoped view.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch, worded for administrators.

No pin was deleted, and no assertion was loosened.

## The card's other items

- Item 1 (one audit entry) is carried by #23890.
- Item 2 (Packages and Installed Apps) was ruled B on decision card #23892 (6216295104). It executes as objectstack-ai/objectui#12675 and #23933.
- Item 4 (39 entries) is checked by whichever of this PR, #23890 and the #23892 work (objectstack-ai/objectui#12675, #23933) lands last. This PR pins only its own part: no top-level Setup entry targets `sys_user_preference` or `sys_account`.

## Measured before the change (`origin/main` at `497518c3f`)

1. **Producer.** `nav_accounts` and `nav_user_preferences` were at `setup-nav.contributions.ts` lines 186 and 187, in `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS`, group `group_advanced`. Every other `app: 'setup'` contributor (cloud-connection twice, mcp, plugin-approvals, plugin-audit, plugin-auth, plugin-security, plugin-sharing, plugin-webhooks, service-datasource, service-messaging) was grepped for `objectName:`, and none names either object.
2. **The User page.** `SysUserDetailPage` had "Linked Accounts" over `sys_account` (`relationshipField: 'user_id'`) and no tab over `sys_user_preference`. The new tab follows the Sessions and Linked Accounts shape.
3. **Every preference row belongs to a user.** `user_id` is `Field.lookup('sys_user', { required: true })`. The record validator refuses an insert without it, and refuses a PATCH that clears it (`required` and `required_cleared` in `record-validator.ts`). A user delete turns the default `set_null` on a required foreign key into `restrict` (`engine.ts`), so deleting a user cannot detach rows. The one producer, objectui's `packages/data-objectstack/src/userState.ts`, writes `user_id: userId` on every insert. Nothing in this repo writes the object server-side, and tenant-wide settings live on `sys_setting` (ADR-0007). No live database was read, so a row written below the engine (a raw driver write) is outside this reading.
4. **Row actions on the tab and on the old grid.** Read in objectui at the pin `daeb77fc84` (the files read are byte-identical at objectui `main` `63d00da`). The object grid gates New, row Edit and row Delete through `resolveAffordance` with `listNew`, `rowEdit` and `rowDelete`. The related list gates them through `relatedNew`, `relatedRowEdit` and `relatedRowDelete` (`packages/core/src/utils/affordanceGrants.ts`). Each pair reads the same CRUD bit (managed-object policy and effective API operations) and the same grant, so New, Edit and Delete get the same verdict on the tab as on the grid. The tab does not have the grid's Import, inline cell edit, bulk delete or `by_user` grouping view. Those stay on the object's own list. Its route is unchanged (the console resolves `/apps/setup/sys_user_preference` from all objects, not from the menu), and a preference record's breadcrumb opens it. `sys_account`'s one row action, `unlink_account`, has `locations: ['list_item', 'record_header']`, and the related-list host offers a child object's `list_item` actions on its rows.
5. **Pins naming the ids or objects.** `caller-scoped-first-list-view.test.ts` (control updated, pin (a) kept by name), `setup-nav-dead-key-tombstone.test.ts` (ledger extended) and `source-hash.test.ts` (orphan check, satisfied by removing the digests). `console-page-nav-entries.test.ts` names neither.

## Search

"From the search" now holds through the user, not directly. Measured in objectui at the same pin: the command palette (`CommandPalette.tsx`) and the full search page (`SearchResultsPage.tsx`) take their object list and their record-search scope from the active app's menu entries. So after this change, typing "preferences" in Setup's palette no longer offers the "User Preferences" list. `sys_user` stays in scope (`nav_users`, and `enable.searchable: true`), so searching for a user's name opens their page, where both tabs are. Neither object's rows were ever searchable: both declare `enable.searchable: false`. A direct palette hit for an object no menu names would be an objectui change, and none is made here.

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` still records "45 Setup destinations" in the Account-detail step. That count is item 4's, re-measured by whichever of this card's changes lands last.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts` (the comment above the per-user UI-state map) and `audit-writers.test.ts` (a case comment) describe an admin editing a row "from Setup's User Preferences grid". The behaviour they describe is unchanged, because an admin's edit from the Preferences tab is the same write. Only the place name is out of date. Not edited, because `plugin-audit` is outside this claim. No carrier.
- `showViewAll` on `record:related_list` (spec `RecordRelatedListProps`, default `true`, described as 'Show "View All" link to see all related records') is not read by any objectui renderer. `RelatedList.tsx` renders its View all link only when a host passes `onViewAll`, and no host does (objectui pin `daeb77fc84`). The new tab sets `showViewAll: true` like its eight siblings on this page. That is the default, so it changes nothing. Filed by the seat as #23941.

## Verification, at head `770f1d617` (after merging `origin/main` at `6d1660dc3`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 73 files and 1136 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts`: 1 file and 2 tests passed. At `a6f35a120`, before the edit, CI's Test Core (2/6) showed it red: "expected [...] to have a length of 34 but got 32".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/platform-app-object-entry-views.test.ts`: before the edit, 1 failed and 49 passed (exit 1), with "(a) no longer judges sys_user_preference". After the edit, 51 passed (exit 0). The 21 dogfood `*.test.ts` files that are not `*.dogfood.test.ts` also ran together: 329 passed and 6 skipped. That subset is chosen by file name, not by whether a file boots; some of the 21 boot a kernel in-process. The 244 `*.dogfood.test.ts` files boot example apps and run in CI's Dogfood Regression Gate. None of them reads Setup's menu, and the two that name `sys_user_preference` read it over the data API, which this change does not touch.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0 at `a6f35a120`. The three edited or new test files are in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (counted with `--listFiles`).
- `pnpm check:i18n`, `pnpm check:platform-checklist` (822/832 anchors resolved, 10 on the named residual) and `pnpm check:doc-authoring`: each exits 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths): 94 commands for the 20 changed paths. 93 exited 0: two needed their prerequisite built first (`check:i18n` needed the CLI, and `check:skill-examples` needed `client-react`), then exited 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads the whole workspace's `dist`), so it is NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it in Build Core, which is green on this head. `--ran` reconciliation: 94 derived, 93 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Ablation, one leg per platform-objects behaviour, each landed with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (it proves the anchor hit and restores the blob to HEAD):
  - re-adding `nav_user_preferences` turns 3 tests red;
  - adding `value` to the Preferences columns turns 1 test red;
  - pointing the tab's list at another object turns 3 tests red.
  - After every leg, `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- CI's families are not re-run here: read them on this PR's checks.
